# Packages the shell needs (Arch / AUR, installed with paru or yay).
# Lines starting with # are ignored by install.sh.

# Required: the shell plus the tools it shells out to
quickshell-git        # the shell itself (Qt6/QtQuick Wayland toolkit)
brightnessctl         # internal-display backlight
ddcutil               # external-monitor brightness over DDC/CI
cliphist              # clipboard history (launcher ':' mode)
wl-clipboard          # wl-copy / wl-paste
hyprsunset            # Night Light
wallust               # palette engine for the theme switcher
cava                  # audio levels for the island's media card
ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd   # nerd-font glyphs

# Optional: only if you bind media keys to playerctl (media itself is native MPRIS)
playerctl

# Platform: a normal Hyprland desktop already has these. Uncomment any you're missing.
# hyprland
# xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
# pipewire
# wireplumber
# networkmanager
# bluez
# bluez-utils
# upower
# polkit
